svg.title: The server world: stock wasmtime serve delivers each request through wasi:http; a generated adapter reads method, path, headers and body, constructs the Request ADT in the guest heap, calls the verified handle function, decodes the returned Response, and drives the outgoing-response resources — guest traps map to a 500 from the host. String-keyed Map operations run in guest code with the host's exact semantics.
svg.text: The same verified handler `vera serve` hosts natively, compiled to a wasi:http/incoming-handler component stock `wasmtime serve` runs unmodified.

g.text: generated adapter — inbound
reads method · path-with-query · headers · body through
the wasi:http interfaces, then constructs the Request ADT
in the guest heap using the compilation's own layouts
handle(@Request -> @Response)
the §9.5.6 validation rules — total, contract-verified,
unchanged from the natively-served program
generated adapter — outbound
decodes the returned Response and drives the
outgoing-response resource sequence
guest trap
→ 500 from the host
in-guest String maps
Map ops are host imports on the core target — but a Vera Map is
two plain guest-heap blocks, so the server world implements the
String-keyed operations in guest code with the host's exact
semantics (position-preserving update, later-insert-wins, growth).
Handlers use map_new / map_insert / map_get unchanged.
the surface, loud at the edges
allowed: IO.print / IO.stderr (serve console) · IO.time · IO.sleep ·
the Random family · the pure language
rejected with a diagnostic: read_line · read_char · read_file ·
write_file · get_env · args · exit — the proxy world has no stdin,
filesystem, or environment

svg.text: v1 limits, each loud: bodies buffered (not streamed) · request headers share the fixed arena (~63 KiB) · out-of-range status or
forbidden header answers 500 · handler IO.print is line-buffered by `wasmtime serve` — end log lines with \n.
`vera run` cannot execute a server-world artifact (no wasi:http in the built-in host) — it points you at `wasmtime serve`.
